parsed.rationale: Both participating records reside under test directories — 'Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkServiceTests.swift' (package: Artwork) and 'Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/NowPlayingServiceTests.swift' (package: AppServices) — making these local test-scoped type aliases that are intentionally defined per-package to avoid cross-package test dependencies. The structural evidence is entirely null (no Jaccard, no shared fields, no differing slots), and both records carry empty name and fields_or_signature values, providing no grounded shape signal to justify extraction. Consolidating test-local mock aliases across package boundaries would couple the AppServices test target to the Artwork test target, which is an anti-pattern in modular Swift package layouts.
